vf06FindingDisposition.finding: KNOWN_PREFILLS (3) - the county caption marker: the build erased the source hint 'Choose the county' at x 291.79-351.35, 11.86pt beyond the right edge of its declared write box
vf06FindingDisposition.disposition: REPAIRED AS A DISPOSITION, NOT AS INK - and the measurement corrects part of the finding
vf06FindingDisposition.how: Measured on the pinned bytes, the erased hint is the appearance of DROPDOWNCOUNTY2, whose annotation flags are /F 0 - the Print bit is CLEAR. It is a screen control that no printed copy of the official CC 6:11 shows, so a flatten that does not carry it forward is correct and the packet must not print it; restoring it would put ink on the filing that the official form does not carry, and the builder's own preservation guard refuses it ((F & 7) === 4 required). There is also no erasure: measured across every page of both fixtures, 0 added words fall outside a declared write box and no white or opaque path is painted at that position. The build's footprint does not reach outside its box; it simply declines to flatten a non-printing control. What IS genuinely lost is a different widget - `enter the county`, /Ff read-only, /F 36 (Print AND NoView), carrying the form's own printed prompt '(Enter the county name)'. That one does print on the official form, and the shared step drops every NoView widget before any per-family disposition is consulted (scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs, dropNonDisplayedWidgets, which this lane is forbidden to edit). All of this is now recorded per document in production-field-map.json under countyCaptionPositionDisposition - each source control with its flags read first hand from the binary, its rect, its carried value, and what became of it - and stated to the participant: the guide now says where the county goes, that DC 1:15 prints a ruled line there while CC 6:11 and CC 6:11.2 print nothing at all, and that the on-screen prompt is absent because it is absent from any printed copy.
vf06FindingDisposition.correctionToTheFinding: VF06 characterised this as the build erasing outside its write box. Measured here, no ink is added and nothing is painted over: the hint is a non-printing screen control that flattening correctly leaves behind. The participant-facing defect VF06 identified is real and is repaired; the mechanism named in the finding is not what the bytes show.
vf06FindingDisposition.residual: OPEN AND OUT OF THIS LANE'S BOUNDARY: the print-flagged NoView prompt '(Enter the county name)' cannot be carried forward without changing dropNonDisplayedWidgets, which treats Hidden and NoView alike. NoView+Print means invisible on screen and printed - the opposite of what the rule assumes - and this is a print deliverable. Recorded for the lane that owns scripts/rcap-official-forms/**.
